checks.assertion: The unchanged draft is retained while a send is pending.
A committed response that never reaches the browser is shown as failed with the draft retained.
Retry reuses the logical identity and resolves to one confirmed message.
Editing a failed draft creates a new logical send instead of reusing the failed identity.
A poll-confirmed message is not changed back to failed when the original response later reports a network error.
The recipient has one unread increment per confirmed logical message and sees the final preview.
Both accounts retain one stored row per logical send, including the edited new message.
No browser exceptions or HTTP 5xx responses during the checked retry flow.
